title: A call stack, drawn
description:
Record function calls and returns to print the call stack at any moment.

```
main
  loadLevel
    readFile
    <- readFile
    parseTiles
  <- loadLevel
stack at deepest point: main > loadLevel > parseTiles (depth 3)
```
hints: The destructor runs when the function returns, even on an early `return`, which is why this works (lesson 1.05).
requirements: A `struct Trace` whose constructor pushes a name onto a global stack and whose destructor pops it.
Indent each line by the depth.
stretch: Compare your printout with the Call Stack window in Visual Studio at a breakpoint.
